gui.vc-audio-distance.title: Audio Distance Settings
gui.vc-audio-distance.model.label: Falloff Model: %s
gui.vc-audio-distance.model.linear.toolt:
Standard Simple Voice Chat behavior.
Volume stays at 100% until the start point, then decays linearly to zero.
gui.vc-audio-distance.model.inverse.tool:
Real-world sound physics: acoustic waves attenuate with the inverse of distance.
Close voices sound natural, warm and smooth, trailing off gently at a distance.
Sharp sound drop-off within the first few meters.
Creates suspenseful gameplay for stealth, horror, and hide-and-seek maps.
gui.vc-audio-distance.attenuation.toolti:
Controls how quickly volume fades with distance.
100% = normal falloff (VoiceChat default)
50% = voice carries further and louder
0% = volume does not decrease at all
gui.vc-audio-distance.min_volume.tooltip:
Minimum audibility at maximum range (%s blocks).
0% = voice fades completely to silence at edge
20%+ = voice remains quietly audible even at max distance
Distance up to which voice stays at maximum 100% volume.
In vanilla Simple Voice Chat, falloff starts halfway (50%).
gui.vc-audio-distance.whisper_multiplier:
Multiplier for whisper attenuation speed.
1.00x = standard whisper decay
1.40x+ = whisper drops off much faster
0.50x = whisper carries further
gui.vc-audio-distance.summary.falloff: 🔵 Fades to %s%% volume at edge (%s blocks)
gui.vc-audio-distance.summary.flat: 🟢 Volume is constant across all %s blocks
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.default.too:
Vanilla Simple Voice Chat settings.
(Linear decay, 100% rate, 0% min volume, starts at 50%)
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.realistic.t:
Realistic 1/r acoustic wave propagation.
Smooth, natural, and immersive falloff for survival.
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.audible.too:
High audibility across long distances.
Clear voice carrying (great for events and servers).
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.atmospheric:
Sharp exponential falloff.
Voice drops rapidly outside a few meters (for horror/stealth).
gui.vc-audio-distance.reset.tooltip: Reset all values to vanilla Simple Voice Chat defaults
